tasks.analysis: Fossils provide valuable information about the history of life on Earth. The preserved remains of ancient organisms are typically found in sedimentary rock. By studying them, scientists can learn about the physical characteristics, behavior, and environments of extinct species. Fossil evidence has been crucial in understanding the process of evolution, showing how species have changed and adapted over millions of years.
